mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three months signals a weakening demand environment, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within a month signals a strengthening supply side, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% within a month signals deflationary pressures, which increases real returns on fixed income investments and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors shift to bonds.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 jobs in a month, it signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) both increase by more than 1% within a month, it signals a strengthening demand environment, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% within a month, it signals inflationary pressures in a high-rate environment, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: inflationary regime with high interest rates
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.
